=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:128-131 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: `EXTRAHEADER_KEYS_OUTPUT` captures stderr together with stdout, so non-key warning lines can be processed as extraheader keys.
  WHY: Both reviewers identify the same root cause: the loop reads every line from the combined output and may feed warning text into `git config --unset-all`, causing bogus unset attempts and obscuring the real diagnostic state.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:144-145 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The script can report a misleading success-style message when the preceding `git config --get-regexp` step failed or when stderr from `unset-all` is written only to a temp file.
  WHY: One reviewer flags that the unset stderr is captured but never shown; another flags that the message printed after a non-zero `get-regexp` result does not distinguish a real git error from “no matching key,” so diagnostics can hide the actual failure mode.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:130-170 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic step leaves fixed-path temporary files in `/tmp` without comprehensive cleanup.
  WHY: Both reviewers note that temp files such as `/tmp/extraheader_stderr` and `/tmp/cp_stderr` are not removed, which can leave stale artifacts behind if the step exits unexpectedly.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:131-135 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The stderr capture files use fixed `/tmp` paths instead of unique per-run names.
  WHY: A reviewer reports that concurrent jobs on the same runner could overwrite each other’s diagnostics, producing mixed or corrupted stderr output.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:132 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: `printf '%s\n' "$EXTRAHEADER_KEYS_STDOUT"` prints a blank line when the variable is empty.
  WHY: The reviewer considers this confusing log output, though not functionally incorrect.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:130-170 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Temporary stderr files (`/tmp/extraheader_stderr`, `/tmp/cp_stderr`, `/tmp/unset_stderr`) are not cleaned up after use
  WHY: These files accumulate in `/tmp`, causing potential disk space issues and could interfere with other processes if names collide. More critically, `/tmp/unset_stderr` is created in each loop iteration but never read, hiding potential git command errors.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:130-170 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Potential race condition with multiple concurrent workflow jobs using same temporary file names
  WHY: If multiple workflow jobs run simultaneously (e.g., in parallel CI runs), they may overwrite each other's temporary stderr files, causing corrupted diagnostics or missed error messages.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:144-145 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `git config --file "$TEMP_GIT_CONFIG" --unset-all "$EXTRAHEADER_KEY" 2>/tmp/unset_stderr` captures stderr but never prints it
  WHY: If the unset operation fails (e.g., key doesn't exist in temp config), the error message is lost in `/tmp/unset_stderr` file, reducing diagnostic value.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:132 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: Prints empty line when `EXTRAHEADER_KEYS_STDOUT` is empty
  WHY: Creates confusing output with blank line in logs when no extraheader keys exist.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:128-131 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: EXTRAHEADER_KEYS_OUTPUT captures both stdout and stderr (2>&1), and then feeds this entire string into a while loop for processing.
  WHY: If git config --get-regexp emits any warnings or diagnostics to stderr while still returning exit code 0, those warning lines will be treated as key names by the while loop. Attempting to run git config --file ... --unset-all on a warning string will fail and produce confusing diagnostic output, potentially masking the real state of the extraheader keys. The script should only process valid key names from stdout.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:144 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic message "unset_rc=skipped (no matching key)" is printed regardless of whether the preceding git config command actually failed.
  WHY: If GETREGEXP_RC is non-zero (indicating a real git error), the script still prints "no matching key". This is misleading for a diagnostic probe; a developer reading the logs won't know if there were truly no keys or if the git command itself died. The error state should be explicitly reported.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:131 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: Temporary config file is not cleaned up if the step is interrupted.
  WHY: Use trap 'rm -f "$TEMP_GIT_CONFIG"' EXIT after creating the temp file.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:135 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: A failure in one unset-all command could potentially interfere with others or shell state depending on flags.
  WHY: Add || true to the git config --unset-all command to ensure diagnostic continuity.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:128-131 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The diagnostic probe captures stderr together with stdout via `2>&1`, then processes every line in `EXTRAHEADER_KEYS_OUTPUT` as a git config key.
  WHY: If `git config --get-regexp` emits warnings or error messages to stderr (which can happen in certain git versions or configurations), those text lines will be fed to the subsequent `git config --unset-all` command as if they were valid keys.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:131-132, 134-135 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The YAML anchor `&git-checkout-diag` is referenced via alias `*git-checkout-diag` in 5 different jobs. While GitHub Actions does support YAML anchors/aliases, the diagnostic step contains shell code with file redirections to fixed paths (`/tmp/extraheader_stderr`, `/tmp/cp_stderr`). When multiple jobs run concurrently on the same runner, these fixed paths could collide.
  WHY: If two jobs with the diagnostic step run on the same runner instance simultaneously, one job could overwrite another's stderr capture file mid-execution, leading to interleaved or corrupted diagnostic output. This could mislead debugging of the exit-128 issue.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:138-139 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The temp files `/tmp/extraheader_stderr` and `/tmp/cp_stderr` are never explicitly removed after use.
  WHY: While these are small files in /tmp, repeated workflow runs could accumulate files. More importantly, in a shared runner environment, stale files from previous runs could affect subsequent diagnostic accuracy if the cleanup trap doesn't fire or if a job is terminated abruptly.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
